_doc: Creator -> Critic -> Formatter prompt chain with a cross-vendor critic (OWNER 2026-09-15). The critic for a deliverable is resolved from a DIFFERENT vendor than the creator whenever a seat is available; same-vendor fallbacks are allowed only as the last candidate and are recorded as cross_vendor=false in the receipt. Seats: claude (Claude Code headless, models opus/sonnet/haiku), codex (Codex CLI, tiers from agent_quota_gate.v1.json), agy (Antigravity, research-only backup: hallucinates, never the sole critic unless allow_agy is set on the spec). Kill switch: env QM_AGENT_CHAIN=0.

claude._envelope_doc: Live finding 2026-09-15: user settings defaultMode=auto let a headless critic run Bash despite --allowedTools. The runner therefore passes --tools <read_only_tools>, --disallowedTools <disallowed_tools>, --permission-mode dontAsk, --max-turns, --strict-mcp-config with an empty MCP config (no connectors).

claude.note: third lens: headless agy print-timed-out (15 min, no answer file) on a 27 KB audit 2026-09-15 07:52Z; stays last until it proves itself

critique._skip_doc: review_ea already runs the build chain codex_build_ea -> codex_review_ea -> claude_review_ea; the generic critic must not double it.
